title: Problem Formulation
html:
Formulating business objectives as specific, solvable machine learning targets.

Core Paradigm Classification

Supervised

Model learns mappings using historical inputs and target labels.
Use Case: Predicting churn, classifying email categories.

Unsupervised

Finding patterns and groupings in unlabeled data.
Use Case: Customer segmentation, fraud anomaly detection.

Reinforcement

Learning via sequential actions to maximize cumulative reward.
Use Case: Game bots (AlphaGo), robotics trajectory optimization.

ML Task Definitions & Scenarios

Task Class Definition Use Case Scenario Primary Metric
Regression Predicting continuous real values. Predicting ride price based on distance. RMSE / MAE
Classification Predicting discrete categorical tags. Flagging if a user comment is toxic. Precision / Recall / F1
Ranking Ordering list items by relevance score. Displaying relevant search results. NDCG / MAP
Recommendation Suggesting personalized content. Recommending movie feeds. Recall@K / Hit Rate
Anomaly Detection Identifying rare, irregular data patterns. Flagging structural network intrusion logs. PR-AUC / Recall
Forecasting Predicting future values chronologically. Forecasting weekly inventory demand. MAPE / RMSE

Use Case: Spam Classifier Formulation Blueprint

• Input: Email body text, sender history, IP logs, metadata.
• Output: Binary output probability `P(Spam)`.
• Type: Supervised Binary Classification.
• Labels: User-flagged "Mark as Spam" actions.
• Metrics: Precision (to minimize False Positives) and F1 Score.
